lines.en: label dormwar16:
scene postfashion1
: Are you okay?! Were you attacked?!
lines.zh: : 你没事吧？！你被袭击了吗？！

lines.en: : I knew leaving you alone for several hours at once was a bad idea!
lines.zh: : 我就知道，一连好几个小时把你一个人丢着是个坏主意！

lines.en: : Come on, we have to get you to the hospital!
lines.zh: : 走吧，我们得送你去医院！

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Touka. I was just trying to be as pretty as you.
lines.zh: : 对不起，Touka。我只是想变得跟你一样漂亮。

lines.en: : You should know that is impossible by now, Yasu. How do you feel? Lightheaded?
lines.zh: : 你早该知道那是不可能的，Yasu。你觉得怎么样？头晕吗？

lines.en: : I have training in first aid. Let's find a sanitary room to stop the bleeding and-
lines.zh: : 我受过急救训练。我们去找个干净点的房间止血，然后——

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure she’s okay, Touka. She just needs to take the crown off.
lines.zh: : 我挺确定她没事的，Touka。她只要把那顶王冠摘下来就行了。

lines.en: scene postfashion2
: You let this happen?! Why?
lines.zh: : 你居然让这种事发生了？！为什么？

lines.en: if yasufashion == True:
: Sensei wants to lay my body down upon the altar and fill me with His love.
lines.zh: : 老师想把我的身体放上祭坛，用祂的爱填满我。

lines.en: : Yasu, come on.
lines.zh: : Yasu，别这样。

lines.en: : You what?!
lines.zh: : 你说什么？！

lines.en: : It means that she won the fashion show.
lines.zh: : 她的意思是她赢了时装秀。

lines.en: : That is absolutely not what she means!
lines.zh: : 她绝对不是这个意思！

lines.en: : Okay, maybe not. But she {i}did{/i} win the fashion show, so...
lines.zh: : 好吧，也许不是。但她{i}确实{/i}赢了时装秀，所以……

lines.en: : A celebration is in order?
lines.zh: : 是不是该庆祝一下？

lines.en: : You absolute heathen!
lines.zh: : 你这彻头彻尾的异教徒！

lines.en: : Are you proud of me, Touka?
lines.zh: : 你为我骄傲吗，Touka？

lines.en: scene postfashion3
: Of course I am. I just don’t want you passing out in some unfamiliar bar due to blood loss.
lines.zh: : 我当然骄傲。我只是不想让你在某个陌生的酒吧里因为失血而昏倒。

lines.en: : Every drop that falls onto the floor will one day be recycled and consumed by His radiance.
lines.zh: : 每一滴落在地上的血，总有一天都会被祂的光辉回收、吞噬。

lines.en: : This blood does not belong to me, Touka. It belongs to God.
lines.zh: : 这血不属于我，Touka。它属于神。

lines.en: : Well, {i}whoever{/i} it belongs to will have to wait. Come with me. And toss that wretched...decoration into the trash while you’re at it.
lines.zh: : 好吧，不管它属于{i}谁{/i}都得等着。跟我来。顺便把那个破……装饰品给我扔进垃圾桶。

lines.en: : I can’t take it home with me?
lines.zh: : 我不能带回家吗？

lines.en: : Absolutely not.
lines.zh: : 绝对不行。

lines.en: else:
: I didn’t {i}let{/i} anything happen...it was part of the contest.
lines.zh: : 我没有“{i}让{/i}”任何事发生……那是比赛的一部分。

lines.en: scene postfashion3
: I’m sorry, Touka. But it appears that I have failed in whatever I was meant to do here today.
lines.zh: : 对不起，Touka。但看来我今天在这里本该做到的事，我搞砸了。

lines.en: : That’s quite alright, Yasu. The competition is the least of my worries right now.
lines.zh: : 那完全没关系，Yasu。眼下这场比赛是我最不担心的东西。

lines.en: : To think your costume would have a real crown of thorns, though...my personal designers would have never suggested something like this.
lines.zh: : 不过真没想到你的服装上会有真的荆棘王冠……我的专属设计师是绝不会提这种建议的。

lines.en: : We should have just had one of them tailor something for you. I’m sure it wouldn’t have been a problem.
lines.zh: : 我们本来该让他们中的一个给你量身做一套的。我相信那完全不成问题。

lines.en: : I am not worthy of the clothes you’d dress me in, Touka. Even your concern is too much for a worm like me.
lines.zh: : 我不配穿你给我准备的衣服，Touka。就连你的关心，对我这样一条虫子来说都太过奢侈。

lines.en: : That may be true, but it does not change the fact that I’d dress you in them regardless.
lines.zh: : 也许吧，但这改变不了我照样会给你穿上的事实。

lines.en: : Kudos to you for being both kind and conceited at once. Not many people can do that so effortlessly.
lines.zh: : 能同时做到既温柔又自大，真是佩服。没几个人能这么毫不费力地做到。

lines.en: scene postfashion4
: You.
: Hey.
: My mother will be here any minute. Why are all of the girls in our class drinking?
lines.zh: : 我妈妈随时会到。为什么我们班上的女生全都在喝酒？

lines.en: : Tsubasa is coming? Why?
lines.zh: : Tsubasa 要来？为什么？

lines.en: : Because I am a [teenage]girl and this is a bar. She’s likely worried for my wellbeing, which is an extremely valid sentiment, if I do say so myself.
lines.zh: : 因为我是个[teenage]女孩，而这里是酒吧。她大概是担心我的安危，这心情我觉得完全合情合理。

lines.en: Well...
Let’s hope Tsubasa is as accepting of that as she is of me having hours and hours of audible sex with one of her daughter’s classmates.
lines.zh: 只希望 Tsubasa 能像接受“我和她女儿的同班同学发出响亮的性爱声一搞就是好几个小时”那样，接受眼前这一幕。

lines.en: : I’ll deal with your mom. Just make sure Yasu doesn’t die or something.
lines.zh: : 你妈妈我来应付。你只要确保 Yasu 别死了之类的就行。

lines.en: : There is no death, there is only-
lines.zh: : 没有死亡，只有——

lines.en: scene postfashion5
: Not right now, you troublesome whelp.
lines.zh: : 现在别说，你这个麻烦的小崽子。

lines.en: : Hehehehahhehehahehahaha~
lines.zh: : Hehehehahhehehahehahaha~

lines.en: if sanafashion == False:
scene postfashion6
: You better have a really good explanation for this.
lines.zh: : 你最好给我一个像样的解释。

lines.en: : Mom...it’s...okay...
lines.zh: : 妈妈……没关系的……

lines.en: : I’m sure the other girl...worked just as hard...
lines.zh: : 我相信另一个女孩……也一样努力了……

lines.en: : Oh, no. He’s not getting off the hook that easily.
lines.zh: : 哦，不。他别想这么轻易就脱身。

lines.en: : My daughter is the single cutest thing on the entire earth. No! The entire planet!
lines.zh: : 我女儿是全世界最可爱的东西。不！是全星球！

lines.en: : Mom...those are...the same-
lines.zh: : 妈妈……那两个……不是一样的——

lines.en: : Quiet, dear. This is between Sensei and me.
lines.zh: : 安静，亲爱的。这是我和老师之间的事。

lines.en: : ...Is it really, though?
lines.zh: : ……真是这样吗？

lines.en: scene postfashion7
: She’s so cute! How could you not choose her?!
lines.zh: : 她这么可爱！你怎么能不选她？！

lines.en: : Sensei...I’m...really sorry about this...
lines.zh: : 老师……这件事……我真的很抱歉……

lines.en: : I don’t mind that I lost...I...I’ve already accepted it...
lines.zh: : 我输了也没关系……我……我已经接受了……

lines.en: : Well I haven’t. I am offended and betrayed and...and a lot of other bad things.
lines.zh: : 我可没有。我觉得受到了冒犯和背叛，还有……还有很多别的糟糕感受。

lines.en: scene postfashion8
: You disgust me.
lines.zh: : 你让我恶心。

lines.en: : You tell him, zombie teacher!
lines.zh: : 说得好，僵尸老师！

lines.en: : You too?
lines.zh: : 你也来？

lines.en: : Ms. Watabe...you don’t have to...
lines.zh: : Watabe 老师……你不用……

lines.en: : I mean he disgusts me in general.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是他本来就让我恶心。

lines.en: : But yes. I also disagree with your decision.
lines.zh: : 不过没错。我也不同意你的决定。

lines.en: : I just thought the other costume was better.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得另一套衣服更好。

lines.en: : These are not “costumes,” you pathetic waste of carbon.
lines.zh: : 这根本不是什么“服装”，你这可悲的碳基废物。

lines.en: : These outfits are a way of life...and offer more insight into the minds of those who wear them than any words possibly can.
lines.zh: : 这些衣服是一种生活方式……它们能让人看穿着者的内心，比任何语言都更深。

lines.en: : Do you think this is all a charade? Is that why you selected the girl who spouted a religious, delirium coated monologue while she should have let her dress do the talking?
lines.zh: : 你以为这一切都是闹着玩的吗？所以你才选了那个本该让衣服说话、却在那儿念叨宗教疯话的女孩？

lines.en: : I should have you fired for this.
lines.zh: : 就凭这个，我就该让你被开除。

lines.en: : Wow...you’re, uhh...really passionate about this kind of stuff, huh?
lines.zh: : 哇……你，呃……对这种事还真是有够狂热的啊？

lines.en: : You don’t understand anything at all.
lines.zh: : 你什么都不懂。

lines.en: : Okay, Wakana. That’s enough...
lines.zh: : 好了，Wakana。够了……

lines.en: : Let’s go home.
lines.zh: : 我们回家吧。

lines.en: else:
scene postfashion9
: I knew you’d make the right choice, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我就知道你会做出正确的选择，老师。

lines.en: : Of course, there was absolutely no way Sana was going to lose when she looks {i}this{/i} cute. It just wouldn’t be possible.
lines.zh: : 当然，Sana {i}这么{/i}可爱，怎么可能会输呢。那根本不可能。

lines.en: : Um...h...hi, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 嗯……你、你好，老师……

lines.en: : Hey, Sana. And congratulations. You looked great up there.
lines.zh: : 嗨，Sana。恭喜你。你在台上好看极了。

lines.en: scene postfashion10
: Hahah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈……

lines.en: : I know I probably shouldn’t be doing this because it’ll obviously embarrass her...but thank you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我知道我大概不该这么做，因为这显然会让她难为情……不过谢谢你，老师。

lines.en: : Sana’s struggled with her self confidence for a long time, and something like this is exactly what she needs to start feeling better about herself.
lines.zh: : Sana 长期以来都在和自信心作斗争，而这样的事正是她开始重新接纳自己所需要的。

lines.en: : I...really don’t think a fashion show is...{i}exactly{/i} what I need...
lines.zh: : 我……真的不觉得一场时装秀……{i}就是{/i}我需要的东西……

lines.en: scene postfashion11
: I beg to differ.
lines.zh: : 我不敢苟同。

lines.en: : Ms. Watabe?...
lines.zh: : Watabe 老师？……

lines.en: : Are you...smiling right now?
lines.zh: : 你……现在是在笑吗？

lines.en: : Silence, lecher.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，色鬼。

lines.en: : You look lovely tonight, Sana.
lines.zh: : 你今晚看起来很美，Sana。

lines.en: scene postfashion12
: You do.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : And unlike the other girl, you actually let your outfit do the talking.
lines.zh: : 而且和另一个女孩不同，你真的让衣服替你说话了。

lines.en: : You didn’t rely on some delirious monologue to stake your claim.
lines.zh: : 你没有靠一段神志不清的独白来宣示自己的主张。

lines.en: : When I was your age, I had trouble expressing myself.
lines.zh: : 我在你这个年纪的时候，也很难表达自己。

lines.en: : And you’re good at it now?
lines.zh: : 那你现在就很擅长了？

lines.en: : I said {i}silence.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我说{i}闭嘴{/i}。

lines.en: : It wasn’t until I started dressing in clothes like this that I truly began to feel like me.
lines.zh: : 直到我开始穿这样的衣服，我才真正开始觉得自己是我自己。

lines.en: : So perhaps this {i}was{/i} what you needed.
lines.zh: : 所以也许这正{i}是{/i}你需要的东西。

lines.en: : And perhaps I still have some clothes lying around that no longer fit me.
lines.zh: : 而且也许我还留着一些已经不合身的衣服。

lines.en: : I’d be happy to hand them down to you if you’d like.
lines.zh: : 如果你愿意，我很乐意把它们送给你。

lines.en: scene postfashion13
: Would you...really do that for me?
lines.zh: : 你……真的愿意为我做这种事？

lines.en: : Assuming I can find them.
lines.zh: : 前提是我能找得到。

lines.en: : I’m sure they’re tucked away in storage now. But I’ll have Osako help me look.
lines.zh: : 我猜它们现在被塞在储物间里了。不过我会让 Osako 帮我一起找。

lines.en: : I...don’t know what to say...
lines.zh: : 我……不知道该说什么……

lines.en: : Thank you...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你……

lines.en: : You’re very welcome.
lines.zh: : 不用谢。

lines.en: scene postfashion14
: Anyway, that’s all I needed to say. I’ll be taking my leave now.
lines.zh: : 总之，我要说的就这些了。我先告辞了。

lines.en: : Need me to call a cab for you? You drank...probably more than I’ve ever seen {i}anyone{/i} drink before.
lines.zh: : 需要我帮你叫辆车吗？你喝的……大概比我见过{i}任何人{/i}喝的都多。

lines.en: : My partner will be driving, but I appreciate the offer.
lines.zh: : 我的伴侣会开车，不过谢谢你的好意。

lines.en: : Until we meet again.
lines.zh: : 后会有期。

lines.en: scene postfashion15
Wakana and Osako exit the bar and I’m suddenly left alone with the two Sakakibara girls.
lines.zh: Wakana 和 Osako 走出了酒吧，转眼间就只剩我和 Sakakibara 母女俩。

lines.en: Well, alone in a loose sense of the word as there are still plenty of other girls around here.
lines.zh: 当然，只是广义上的“只剩”，因为这附近还有一大堆别的女孩。

lines.en: : P...Partner?
lines.zh: : 伴、伴侣？

lines.en: : Are they on a...team together?
lines.zh: : 她们是……一个队伍的吗？

lines.en: : That means they’re in a relationship, dear.
lines.zh: : 那是说她们在交往，亲爱的。

lines.en: scene postfashion16
: Oh...wow...
: Sidenote, did you interview someone for a job this morning, Sara?
lines.zh: : 顺便问一句，Sara，你今天上午是不是面试了一个人？

lines.en: scene postfashion17
: I did, but...how did you know that?
lines.zh: : 是面试了，不过……你怎么知道的？

lines.en: : You’re not stalking me, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会是在跟踪我吧？

lines.en: : I am not stalking you.
lines.zh: : 我没有在跟踪你。

lines.en: : It’s okay if you {i}are{/i} stalking me, though. I just want to know so I don’t go out without my makeup on or something.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是{i}真的{/i}在跟踪我，也没关系。我只是想知道，这样我就不会素颜出门什么的。

lines.en: : Sara, I’m not stalking you.
lines.zh: : Sara，我没有在跟踪你。

lines.en: : Are you maybe {i}considering{/i} stalking me? Because I really don’t mind.
lines.zh: : 那你有没有{i}考虑{/i}过跟踪我？因为我真的不介意。

lines.en: : Sara, interview.
lines.zh: : Sara，说面试的事。

lines.en: : Oh, right.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。

lines.en: : Yeah, I had an interview with a woman named Yuki. She’s a recovering addict and-
lines.zh: : 嗯，我面试了一个叫 Yuki 的女人。她是个正在戒除毒瘾的人，然后——

lines.en: : I know her. She’s a friend of mine.
lines.zh: : 我认识她。她是我朋友。

lines.en: scene postfashion18
: Well, that’s...a surprise.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，这可真是……意外。

lines.en: : She doesn’t seem like your type.
lines.zh: : 她看起来不像你会喜欢的类型。

lines.en: : It’s another one of Sana’s classmates’ mothers.
lines.zh: : 她是 Sana 另一个同班同学的妈妈。

lines.en: : She and her daughter don’t really talk anymore, though.
lines.zh: : 不过她和她女儿已经基本不来往了。

lines.en: : That’s a shame. She seemed really nice.
lines.zh: : 真遗憾。她看起来人挺好的。

lines.en: : A little rough around the edges, sure. But she’s not asking for much and...it would be nice to start having this place open during the day instead of just at night.
lines.zh: : 确实有点粗糙，没错。但她要求不多，而且……要是这地方白天也能开门，不只是晚上营业，那就好了。

lines.en: : She was a little hesitant about wearing the uniform, though. So I’m going to have to figure out a way to get her one with pants like Sana has.
lines.zh: : 不过她对穿制服有点犹豫。所以我得想办法给她弄一套像 Sana 那样的裤子款。

lines.en: : You could probably start by...buying pants.
lines.zh: : 你大概可以……先买条裤子。

lines.en: : You make it sound so easy.
lines.zh: : 你说得倒轻巧。

lines.en: : They’re...just pants.
lines.zh: : 那不就是……条裤子嘛。

lines.en: : Oh my. It’s quite lively in here.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。这里可真热闹。

lines.en: scene postfashion19
: Oh my God. Who is that?
lines.zh: : 天哪。那是谁？

lines.en: : We have an actual customer and there are like ten [high_school] girls drinking in here.
lines.zh: : 我们这儿来了一位真正的客人，可这里还有大概十个[high_school]女孩在喝酒。

lines.en: : Sana, your mother is going to jail.
lines.zh: : Sana，你妈妈要进监狱了。

lines.en: : I...think that's...Touka's mom...
lines.zh: : 我……觉得那是……Touka 的妈妈……

lines.en: scene postfashion20
: Oh, wonderful. I was beginning to worry that I may have walked into the wrong establishment.
lines.zh: : 哦，太好了。我刚才还在担心自己是不是走错店了。

lines.en: : You haven’t seen my daughter anywhere, have you?
lines.zh: : 你们有谁看到我女儿了吗？

lines.en: : I don’t intend to get in her way, I just want to make sure she hasn’t run off to a strip club or something of the like.
lines.zh: : 我无意打扰她，我只是想确认她没有跑去了什么脱衣舞俱乐部之类的地方。

lines.en: : That is certainly a strange assumption to have about your daughter.
lines.zh: : 对自己女儿做这种假设，还真是奇怪。

lines.en: : I can’t help but assume the worst at times.
lines.zh: : 我有时候就是忍不住往最坏的方向想。

lines.en: : Well that’s just rude to strippers.
lines.zh: : 那对脱衣舞娘也太失礼了。

lines.en: scene postfashion21
: Tsubasa?! What are you doing here?!
lines.zh: : Tsubasa？！你在这儿干什么？！

lines.en: : Are you going to party with us?
lines.zh: : 你要跟我们一起开派对吗？

lines.en: : Oh, no. I’m afraid my partying days are o-
lines.zh: : 哦，不。我恐怕我的派对岁月已经——

lines.en: : Actually, I don’t believe I’ve ever even had any partying days.
lines.zh: : 其实，我觉得我从来就没有过什么派对岁月。

lines.en: : How sad.
lines.zh: : 真可悲。

lines.en: scene postfashion22
: Heeeeeey! I’m Sara. I own this place.
lines.zh: : 嘿——！我是 Sara。这家店是我的。

lines.en: : Oh my God, you are so cute. You and Sana are like, identical.
lines.zh: : 天哪，你也太可爱了。你和 Sana 简直一模一样。

lines.en: : Tsubasa Tsukioka. Pleasure to meet your acquaintance.
lines.zh: : Tsubasa Tsukioka。幸会。

lines.en: scene postfashion23
: Wait...Tsukioka...
lines.zh: : 等等……Tsukioka……

lines.en: : You mean like the bubble wrap family that {i}isn’t{/i} Ayane’s?
lines.zh: : 你是说那个{i}不是{/i} Ayane 家的、做气泡纸的家族？

lines.en: : Is {i}that{/i} where your money comes from?
lines.zh: : 你的钱就是从{i}那{/i}儿来的？

lines.en: : A portion of it. And yes, that would be me.
lines.zh: : 其中一部分。没错，就是我。

lines.en: : But...what would someone like you be doing in a place like this?
lines.zh: : 可是……像你这样的人来这种地方干什么？

lines.en: : Her daughter’s in our class.
lines.zh: : 她女儿在我们班上。

lines.en: : She...
: She wasn’t drinking, was she?
lines.zh: : 她没在喝酒吧？

lines.en: : She’s cleaning blood off of Yasu right now.
lines.zh: : 她这会儿正在给 Yasu 擦血。

lines.en: scene postfashion24
: Oh thank God...I thought this was the end for me.
lines.zh: : 哦谢天谢地……我还以为我完了呢。

lines.en: : I mean, there are still a bunch of other [high_school]ers drinking in here.
lines.zh: : 我是说，这儿还有一堆别的[high_school]生在喝酒。

lines.en: : Yes, but none of them have nearly as much influence as the daughter of the Tsukioka family.
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过她们谁也没有 Tsukioka 家的女儿那么有影响力。

lines.en: : I have no idea what I’d do if she were to get drunk on my watch.
lines.zh: : 要是她在我眼皮底下喝醉了，我真不知道该怎么办。

lines.en: : I don’t think it would really matter. Tsubasa’s one of those cool moms who lets her kids do whatever they want.
lines.zh: : 我觉得根本无所谓。Tsubasa 是那种很酷的妈妈，孩子们想干什么都让干。

lines.en: : It is true that I allow Touka to partake in wine at family dinners, though I’m not quite sure how I’d feel about her drinking any more than that.
lines.zh: : 我确实允许 Touka 在家庭晚餐时喝点葡萄酒，不过要是比这再多，我就不太确定了。

lines.en: : Is that something common- *ahem*
lines.zh: : 这是不是普通人常……咳咳

lines.en: : Is that something the lower middle class does often?
lines.zh: : 这是不是下层中产阶级经常做的事？

lines.en: scene postfashion25
: Oh yeah. I mean, none of us really do it all that much. But it’s a pretty normal bonding experience for girls our age.
lines.zh: : 哦对。我是说，我们其实也没怎么喝。不过对我们这个年纪的女孩来说，这是挺正常的联谊方式。

lines.en: : Bonding, you say?
lines.zh: : 联谊，你说？

lines.en: : So, girls who consume alcohol together tend to become friends?
lines.zh: : 那么，一起喝酒的女孩就会变成朋友？

lines.en: : Without overcomplicating things, yeah. That’s kinda how it works.
lines.zh: : 别想复杂了，是的。差不多就是这么回事。

lines.en: : If that’s the case, I don’t mind at all.
lines.zh: : 如果是这样，那我完全不介意。

lines.en: : Don’t let my presence here dissuade you from doing as you’d do otherwise.
lines.zh: : 别因为我在这里，你们就不做本来要做的事。

lines.en: : Enjoy your youth, Chika. And, if it’s no trouble-
lines.zh: : 好好享受青春吧，Chika。另外，如果方便的话——

lines.en: : Don’t worry. I was planning on inviting Touka over to hang out with Yumi and me as soon as I saw her again.
lines.zh: : 别担心。我本来就打算一见到 Touka 就邀请她来跟 Yumi 和我一起玩。

lines.en: : Splendid. Thank you so much, dear.
lines.zh: : 太好了。非常感谢你，亲爱的。

lines.en: : Hey...Tsubasa, if you’d like, you’re free to come talk to me at the bar.
lines.zh: : 嘿……Tsubasa，如果你愿意，随时可以来吧台找我聊聊。

lines.en: : The only other mom here right now is off talking to one of the girls, but I’d be happy to get to know you.
lines.zh: : 现在这里唯一的另一位妈妈正跑去跟某个女孩说话，不过我很乐意认识认识你。

lines.en: : Maki is?
lines.zh: : Maki 吗？

lines.en: scene postfashion26
: Yeah. The one with the brown hair and glasses.
lines.zh: : 对。棕色头发、戴眼镜那个。

lines.en: : Nodoka?
lines.zh: : Nodoka？

lines.en: Oh god.
lines.zh: 哦，天哪。

lines.en: I can only imagine what would happen if those two...
lines.zh: 我简直不敢想象那两个人凑到一起会……

lines.en: : I need to go talk to them.
lines.zh: : 我得过去跟她们说说。

lines.en: : Uhh...okay! You know where to find us if you get bored!
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧！你要是无聊了，知道上哪儿找我们！

lines.en: scene postfashion27
I make my way over to Nodoka and Maki and breathe a sigh of both relief and disappointment to find their clothes still on.
lines.zh: 我走向 Nodoka 和 Maki，看到她们衣服还好好穿在身上，松了一口气，同时又有点失望。

lines.en: : And that essentially sums up my opinions on the matter. Do you agree, Maki?
lines.zh: : 基本上，这就是我对这件事的看法。你同意吗，Maki？

lines.en: : I agree wholeheartedly, Nodoka. And I’m very pleased to find that there are girls your age who have such well thought out opinions on the subject.
lines.zh: : 我举双手赞成，Nodoka。而且我很高兴发现，你这样年纪的女孩对这个问题能有如此成熟的见解。

lines.en: : Okay. What did I miss?
lines.zh: : 好吧。我错过什么了？

lines.en: scene postfashion28
: Oh, Sensei. Wonderful. A male’s opinion would actually be quite beneficial to this discussion.
lines.zh: : 哦，老师。太好了。这件事能有个男性的意见其实很有帮助。

lines.en: : And that discussion would be?...
lines.zh: : 那你们在讨论什么？……

lines.en: : Anal.
lines.zh: : 肛交。

lines.en: : How did you get to that point of comfort with one another in the five minutes you have been talking?
lines.zh: : 你们才聊了五分钟，是怎么熟到这个程度的？

lines.en: : Well, we kind of started there since Nodoka’s opening line was asking me if I wanted to come back to her dorm room.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我们基本上就是从这儿开始的，因为 Nodoka 的开场白是问我愿不愿意跟她回宿舍。

lines.en: : Nodoka, come on.
lines.zh: : Nodoka，别这样。

lines.en: : Did you expect any less of me, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你对我还能有更高的期待吗，老师？

lines.en: : No, but that’s Makoto’s mom. Don’t you think that might be adding insult to injury?
lines.zh: : 没有，可那是 Makoto 的妈妈。你不觉得这有点伤口上撒盐吗？

lines.en: scene postfashion27
: I won’t tell if you don’t.
lines.zh: : 你不说，我就不说。

lines.en: : Thanks, but you’re a little too [young]for me.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，不过你对我来说有点太[young]了。

lines.en: : I would also be open to the prospect of watching you have sex with my teacher.
lines.zh: : 我也很乐意看你们两个在我面前做爱。

lines.en: : Nodoka, please.
lines.zh: : Nodoka，拜托。

lines.en: : Maybe another time. I have to stick around in case anybody needs a ride home tonight.
lines.zh: : 下次吧。我今晚还得留在这儿，万一有人需要搭车回家呢。

lines.en: : A - If you’re okay with that, you may as well just be okay with Nodoka in general.
lines.zh: : A——既然你能接受那个，那你对 Nodoka 大概也无所谓了吧。

lines.en: : And B - You should put the wine down if you’re going to be a designated driver.
lines.zh: : 还有 B——你要当指定司机，就该把酒放下了。

lines.en: scene postfashion28
: Since when are you the responsible one?
lines.zh: : 你什么时候变成那个负责任的人了？

lines.en: : Since I stumbled upon the two biggest deviants in Kumon-mi getting to know one another.
lines.zh: : 从我在 Kumon-mi 撞见最大的两个变态正在互相认识开始。

lines.en: : {i}Three{/i} biggest deviants, good sir. You know very well that you are one of us.
lines.zh: : 是{i}三个{/i}最大的变态，好先生。你心里很清楚，你也是我们中的一员。

lines.en: if futabalust15 == True:
: Can confirm.
lines.zh: : 可以证实。

lines.en: : Can {i}definitely{/i} confirm.
lines.zh: : {i}绝对{/i}可以证实。

lines.en: : You know what, I’ll just leave you two alone. I should probably be evenly distributing my time anyway.
lines.zh: : 算了，我还是不打扰你们俩了。反正我也该把时间平均分配一下。

lines.en: : Feel free to come back the moment one of us starts moaning.
lines.zh: : 等我们其中一个开始呻吟的时候，你随时可以回来。

lines.en: : I absolutely will. And thank you for the heads up.
lines.zh: : 我一定会。谢谢你的提醒。

lines.en: scene black
scene postfashion29
: Yo!
: Hey...
: Hey. What’s going on over here?
lines.zh: : 嗨。你们这边在干什么？

lines.en: : Otoha and I are about to have alcohol for the first time, but we’re both really nervous.
lines.zh: : Otoha 和我马上要第一次喝酒了，可我们俩都特别紧张。

lines.en: : Do they not have to put the nutritional facts on the back of beer or something? What is this?
lines.zh: : 啤酒背面不用标营养成分表之类的吗？这到底是什么东西？

lines.en: : Why is that what you’re concerned about?
lines.zh: : 你为什么在意这个？

lines.en: scene postfashion30
: Dude, Futaba won’t do it with us and I’m trying to prove to her that it’s fine.
lines.zh: : 哥们，Futaba 不肯跟我们一起喝，我想向她证明这没什么。

lines.en: : I’m...trying to cut back on calories and...I don’t think I should really be drinking...
lines.zh: : 我……正在努力减少卡路里摄入，而且……我觉得我真的不该喝酒……

lines.en: : Hey, you’re a smart guy. Can Futaba drink with us without having to worry about her weight?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你是个聪明人。Futaba 跟我们一起喝，会不会让她担心体重？

lines.en: : Futaba shouldn’t worry about her weight at all. She’s adorable.
lines.zh: : Futaba 根本就不该为体重操心。她可爱极了。

lines.en: scene postfashion31
: Wha-
: Why would you just randomly compliment me like that?!
lines.zh: : 你干嘛突然这么夸我？！

lines.en: : Wow. I think that was the first time I’ve ever seen you say anything that was genuinely nice and not completely weird.
lines.zh: : 哇。这大概是我第一次听你说一句真心好听、又完全不奇怪的话。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == True:
: Yeah! Sensei can be pretty awesome when he’s not fist deep inside the girl you like.
lines.zh: : 对吧！只要老师的拳头没有深埋在你喜欢的女孩身体里，他还挺棒的。

lines.en: scene postfashion32
: Okay, seriously. What the hell happened with you two?
lines.zh: : 好了，说真的。你们俩到底怎么回事？

lines.en: else:
: Yeah! Sensei’s a super awesome guy who does a lot of super nice things!
lines.zh: : 就是啊！老师是个超棒的人，还做了很多超好的事！

lines.en: : You can even flash him or wear a bathing suit and lay on his lap and he won’t even touch you. It’s really cool.
lines.zh: : 你就算对他走光，或者穿着泳衣躺在他腿上，他都不会碰你一下。真的很酷。

lines.en: : I will...keep that in mind.
lines.zh: : 我……会记住的。

lines.en: : Senseiiiiiiiii! Over here!
lines.zh: : 老师——！这边这边！

lines.en: scene postfashion33
I make my way across the room to find four girls who have apparently decided {i}against{/i} drinking tonight.
lines.zh: 我穿过房间走过去，发现四个今晚显然决定{i}不{/i}喝酒的女孩。

lines.en: : Hey! A few of us were gonna go back to the hotel soon and we wanted to know if you’d want to come with us.
lines.zh: : 嘿！我们几个准备回酒店了，想问你要不要一起。

lines.en: : Already? I was under the impression this was some sort of afterparty.
lines.zh: : 这就走了？我还以为这是某种 afterparty 呢。

lines.en: : Who says there can’t be an afterparty at the hotel as well?
lines.zh: : 谁说酒店里就不能也开一场 afterparty？

lines.en: : Yeah, Sara doesn’t have a kitchen and the four of us are hungry, so we were gonna stop and get food or something on the way.
lines.zh: : 对啊，Sara 这儿没有厨房，而且我们四个都饿了，所以打算路上顺便买点吃的什么的。

lines.en: : You don’t want to drink?
lines.zh: : 你们不想喝酒？

lines.en: : I can’t drink. I will die.
lines.zh: : 我不能喝酒。我会死的。

lines.en: : You won’t {i}die{/i}, Tsuneyo. You’ll just pass out again.
lines.zh: : 你不会{i}死{/i}的，Tsuneyo。你只是又会昏过去而已。

lines.en: : And be assaulted by the tiny athletic girl again? No thank you.
lines.zh: : 然后再被那个娇小的运动少女袭击一次？谢了，不必。

lines.en: : I will accept my death with pride like a true samurai.
lines.zh: : 我会像个真正的武士那样，骄傲地接受我的死亡。

lines.en: : Suit yourself.
lines.zh: : 随你便。

lines.en: : Oh my God, Sensei. You should have seen Tsuneyo’s reaction to the test of courage thing we did. It was hilarious.
lines.zh: : 天哪，老师。你真该看看 Tsuneyo 在我们那个试胆大会里的反应。太搞笑了。

lines.en: : There is nothing hilarious about the death of perfectly good noodles.
lines.zh: : 上好的拉面之死有什么好笑的。

lines.en: : Test of courage?
lines.zh: : 试胆大会？

lines.en: : Yeah. Most of us went to my house during the stupid date contest thing and Maya and Tsuneyo had to try to outlast each other in rooms we decorated.
lines.zh: : 对。那个蠢约会比赛的时候，我们大部分人都去了我家，Maya 和 Tsuneyo 要在我们布置好的房间里比谁撑得久。

lines.en: scene postfashion34
: Yeah...Maya actually seemed really shaken up afterwards. I’m kind of worried about her.
lines.zh: : 是啊……Maya 之后看起来真的很受打击。我有点担心她。

lines.en: : This is {i}Maya{/i} you’re talking about. I’m sure she’s fine.
lines.zh: : 你说的可是 {i}Maya{/i}。我肯定她没事。

lines.en: : Ahh, another person who understands the true horror that is the death of the ultimate entree.
lines.zh: : 啊，又来一个懂得“究极主菜之死”的真正恐怖的人。

lines.en: : I think Maya’s room was a little different, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Maya 的房间可不太一样，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : You’re not going to come with us, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不跟我们走，对吧？

lines.en: : I think I’ll stay here for a little while longer. I haven’t even had a drink yet.
lines.zh: : 我想我再在这儿待一会儿。我还没喝过酒呢。

lines.en: : Why drink anything when you can drink our love?
lines.zh: : 有什么好喝的，喝我们的爱不就行了？

lines.en: if ayanelust15 == True:
: Are you sure you’re even okay to be hanging out with people right now, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 你确定你现在这种状态还适合跟人待在一起吗，Ayane？

lines.en: : Yup! Why wouldn’t I be?
lines.zh: : 当然！为什么不适合？

lines.en: : It’s been a totally normal weekend and I’m totally good because only good things have happened.
lines.zh: : 这个周末完全正常，我好得很，因为发生的全是好事。

lines.en: else:
: {i}What does that even mean?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那到底是什么意思？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Whatever you want it to mean.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你想让它是什么意思，它就是什么意思。{/i}

lines.en: scene postfashion35
: Hah...well, if Sensei isn’t going to come, there’s not really a point in hanging around here any longer.
lines.zh: : 哈……好吧，既然老师不去，那我们也没什么理由继续待在这儿了。

lines.en: : Molly took off as soon as the fashion show ended and the Yumi versus Io contest is obviously not going anywhere.
lines.zh: : Molly 时装秀一结束就跑了，Yumi 对 Io 的比赛显然也不会有什么进展。

lines.en: : What even is their contest?
lines.zh: : 她们那到底算什么比赛？

lines.en: : Just to see whoever joins in on the festivities first.
lines.zh: : 就看谁先加入这场狂欢呗。

lines.en: : But Io isn’t even here right now and the contest is basically over, so I’m pretty sure Yumi is going to win by default.
lines.zh: : 不过 Io 现在根本不在这儿，比赛基本上已经结束了，所以我敢肯定 Yumi 会自动获胜。

lines.en: : You suuuuuuure you don’t wanna come with us?
lines.zh: : 你真的真的真的不跟我们走吗？

lines.en: : Are you going to drug me if I say yes?
lines.zh: : 如果我说好，你们会给我下药吗？

lines.en: scene postfashion36
: What do you think, Ayane? Could the two of us carry him back together?
lines.zh: : 你怎么看，Ayane？我们俩能一起把他抬回去吗？

lines.en: : Not without a lot of attention from anyone on the street. But if we wait a few more hours-
lines.zh: : 在街上不引起一大堆人注意的话不行。不过要是再等几个小时——

lines.en: : No one is drugging my [uncle]! You’re all insane!
lines.zh: : 谁也不许给我[uncle]下药！你们全都疯了！

lines.en: : He is large, but I think I could dispose of him alone.
lines.zh: : 他是块头大，但我觉得我一个人就能处理掉。

lines.en: : We’re talking about bringing him back to the hotel...not dumping his body, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 我们说的是把他带回酒店……不是抛尸，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, you don’t actually want to murder me, right?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，你应该不是真的想杀了我吧？

lines.en: : Would you look at the time?
lines.zh: : 你看现在几点了？

lines.en: : We should probably get going.
lines.zh: : 我们差不多该走了。

lines.en: : What did I ever do to you?
lines.zh: : 我到底对你做什么了？

lines.en: : You walked out on our family, you bastard.
lines.zh: : 你抛弃了我们这个家，你这个混蛋。

lines.en: : And now our child is all alone because the Emerald Guardian wanted to scare me with soup.
lines.zh: : 而现在我们的孩子孤零零一个人，就因为翡翠守卫想用汤吓唬我。

lines.en: : Look what you have done.
lines.zh: : 看看你干的好事。

lines.en: : {i}Look what you have done.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}看看你干的好事。{/i}

lines.en: : I’m so confused.
lines.zh: : 我彻底糊涂了。

lines.en: scene postfashion37
: Anyway...I guess just...let us know if you want to come back early or...want us to pick up anything at the convenience store for you.
lines.zh: : 总之……我就……你想早点回来的话就跟我们说一声，或者……要我们顺路在便利店给你带点什么。

lines.en: : Maybe even a roll of Touka’s favorite {i}candy{/i} if you know what I’m saying.
lines.zh: : 也许还能带一卷 Touka 最爱的{i}糖果{/i}，如果你懂我意思的话。

lines.en: : You talk the talk, but can you walk the walk, Noriko?
lines.zh: : 你嘴上说得厉害，真有那个本事吗，Noriko？

lines.en: : Step on me, Daddy.
lines.zh: : 踩我吧，爸爸。

lines.en: scene postfashion38
: Noriko, what the fuck?!
lines.zh: : Noriko，你他妈搞什么？！

lines.en: : Uhhhhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃……

lines.en: : This is why you walked out on us?! Because you had another daughter?!
lines.zh: : 你抛弃我们就是为了这个？！因为你还有另一个女儿？！

lines.en: : Sensei! Over here!
lines.zh: : 老师！这边！

lines.en: : Oh, thank god.
lines.zh: : 哦，谢天谢地。

lines.en: scene postfashion39
: Afterparty’s barely even started and you’re already bein’ invited back to the hotel with a group of girls.
lines.zh: : afterparty 才刚开始，你就已经被一群女孩邀请回酒店了。

lines.en: : Where do you get off?
lines.zh: : 你凭什么啊？

lines.en: : How is this in any way my fault?
lines.zh: : 这到底怎么怪到我了？

lines.en: : Did you enjoy the dorm war, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师，你喜欢这次宿舍大战吗？

lines.en: : I’ll admit that the idea seemed a bit childish when it was first pitched, but I do think we’ve managed to make at least some semblance of progress in terms of camaraderie.
lines.zh: : 我承认，这个点子刚被提出来的时候显得有点幼稚，但我确实觉得，至少在同伴情谊方面，我们取得了某种程度上的进展。

lines.en: : It has...certainly been an interesting two days, to say the very least.
lines.zh: : 这……绝对是很有意思的两天，至少可以这么说。

lines.en: : Why aren’t you two out talking to the others, though? I figured you’d want a break after putting all of this together.
lines.zh: : 不过你们俩怎么不去跟其他人聊聊？策划了这么一整场，我还以为你们会想休息一下。

lines.en: scene postfashion40
: That’s precisely {i}why{/i} we’re not “mingling” with the others at the moment.
lines.zh: : 这正是我们现在没有跟其他人“打成一片”的{i}原因{/i}。

lines.en: : Well, that and the fact that it would be illegal for either of us to drink.
lines.zh: : 这个，再加上我们俩喝酒都是违法的。

lines.en: : I’m just really tiny and don’t want to get drunk and have you do perverted stuff to me while I’m unconscious.
lines.zh: : 我只是个子特别小，不想喝醉了趁我昏过去的时候被你做些变态的事。

lines.en: : Uta, please don’t make me out to be some sort of predator.
lines.zh: : Uta，别把我描绘成什么捕食者好吗。

lines.en: : Weeeeeeeeell-
scene postfashion41
: So, what are you going to do now?
lines.zh: : 那么，你接下来打算做什么？

lines.en: : We’re spending one more night at the hotel before announcing the results in the morning.
lines.zh: : 我们还要在酒店再住一晚，明天早上才宣布结果。

lines.en: if ayanelust15 == True or futabalust15 == True:
: Speaking of announcing the results...have any of the girls mentioned anything about bonus contests?
lines.zh: : 说到宣布结果……有没有哪个女孩提过什么附加比赛？

lines.en: : Yes. And it is taking every fiber of my being to not imagine what that could possibly mean.
lines.zh: : 有。而我正用尽全力不去想象那到底意味着什么。

lines.en: : I can assure you that any and all non-supervised contests have been entirely wholesome in nature.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，所有没有监督的比赛在性质上都绝对纯洁。

lines.en: else:
: Why not just announce them now?
lines.zh: : 为什么不现在就宣布？

lines.en: : Probs because half the class is missing or drunk and the other half is winding down.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为一半的人要么不在，要么醉了，另一半正在收尾。

lines.en: : Gotta give everybody a little room to breathe before we shatter the dreams of ten girls.
lines.zh: : 在打碎十个女孩的梦想之前，总得给大家留点喘息的空间。

lines.en: scene postfashion42
: Oh! I've been meaning to ask, but you haven’t seen Io anywhere, have you?
lines.zh: : 哦！我一直想问，你有没有在哪儿看到 Io？

lines.en: : I feel like you've been looking for her nonstop this entire weekend.
lines.zh: : 我感觉你整个周末都在不停地找她。

lines.en: : Because I pretty much have been!
lines.zh: : 因为我确实一直在找！

lines.en: : She told me she was gonna come hang out here tonight, but she’s been acting kind of weird since this morning.
lines.zh: : 她跟我说她今晚会来这里玩，可她从今天早上开始就有点不对劲。

lines.en: : Like, she didn’t even stay in the hotel last night.
lines.zh: : 比如说，她昨晚甚至没住在酒店。

lines.en: Oh yes she did.
lines.zh: 哦，她当然住了。

lines.en: : I know she’s not really the type to get involved in this kinda stuff, but I can’t help but worry about her.
lines.zh: : 我知道她本来就不是那种会掺和这种事的人，可我还是忍不住担心她。

lines.en: : I can relate to that.
lines.zh: : 我能理解。

lines.en: : Well, not so much the part about acting weird, but about worrying for a friend’s wellbeing.
lines.zh: : 好吧，倒不是说她举止奇怪那部分，而是为朋友的安危担心那部分。

lines.en: : Miku didn’t come tonight for her own personal reasons, so of course I’m concerned about her in a way similar to how you feel about Io.
lines.zh: : Miku 今晚因为个人原因没来，所以我当然也会替她担心，就像你担心 Io 一样。

lines.en: : I don’t even care about the contest thingy anymore. I just want her to have fun.
lines.zh: : 我现在连比赛什么的都不在乎了。我只想让她玩得开心。

lines.en: : Not to stray too far from the topic at hand, but...Yumi {i}has{/i} cooperated in at least some form, sooooo...
lines.zh: : 别跑题太远，不过……Yumi 至少在某种程度上{i}配合了{/i}，所以嘛……

lines.en: : She provided an interview prior to Chika’s portion of the date war and is now off in the corner with Chika and Touka.
lines.zh: : 她在 Chika 那一段约会大战之前接受了采访，现在正跟 Chika 和 Touka 待在角落里。

lines.en: : Okay, yeah. Whatever. Yumi wins the wallflower cooperation contest.
lines.zh: : 行吧，行吧。Yumi 赢得壁花配合大赛。

lines.zh:
一楼：[dorm1warpoints]

lines.en: : Just...if you see Io, let me know. Okay?
lines.zh: : 总之……你要是看到 Io，就告诉我一声。好吗？

lines.en: : Got it.
lines.zh: : 收到。

lines.en: : I’m going to go pay a visit to those girls in the corner now, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我现在要去角落那边看看那几个女孩了。

lines.en: : I’m a little interested in observing how two of them in particular act in a “party” setting.
lines.zh: : 我有点好奇，想观察其中两个人在“派对”场合下是什么样子。

lines.en: scene postfashion43
: {i}Please{/i} do not say or do anything strange.
lines.zh: : {i}请{/i}别说奇怪的话，也别做奇怪的事。

lines.en: : It’s unprofessional enough that you’re watching a bunch of [high_school] girls get drunk, but-
lines.zh: : 你盯着一群[high_school]女孩喝醉看已经够不专业了，不过——

lines.en: : Uta, do me a favor and get Makoto a drink. She needs it.
lines.zh: : Uta，帮我个忙，给 Makoto 拿杯酒。她需要。

lines.en: : Okay, but I’m closin’ my eyes the second you start touching her unconscious body in inappropriate places.
lines.zh: : 行，不过你一开始对她昏迷的身体乱摸不该摸的地方，我马上就闭上眼睛。

lines.en: : Hah...
: I’m so tired...
lines.zh: : 我好累……

lines.en: scene postfashion44
: Come on! Live a little! Just one!
lines.zh: : 来嘛！活得随性点！就一杯！

lines.en: : The fuck do you gain from me drinking? I have to watch your sister tonight.
lines.zh: : 我喝酒你他妈能捞到什么好处？我今晚还得看着你妹妹。

lines.en: : Yumi, it’s one beer. It’s not going to affect whether or not you’re able to babysit.
lines.zh: : Yumi，就一杯啤酒而已。不会影响你能不能当保姆的。

lines.en: : There are adults everywhere, too. Nothing bad is going to happen, really.
lines.zh: : 而且到处都是大人。真的不会出什么事的。

lines.en: : Oh my. I’ve heard about this. But to think I’d go from being a loner to experiencing “peer pressure” in less than a week is quite jarring.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。我听说过这个词。不过想想看，我不到一周之内就从独来独往的人变成了体验“同辈压力”，还真是够冲击的。

lines.en: scene postfashion45
: Touka~ Let’s have fun!
lines.zh: : Touka~ 我们来玩嘛！

lines.en: : I’ve been wanting to hang out with you since you transferred in and we haven’t really gotten a chance yet.
lines.zh: : 你转学过来之后我就一直想跟你一起玩，可我们一直没什么机会。

lines.en: : Isn’t now like, the best possible time?
lines.zh: : 现在不就是最好的时机吗？

lines.en: : I...suppose it’s as good a time as any, but I don’t quite understand the need for alcohol.
lines.zh: : 我……想这确实是个不错的时机，不过我不太明白为什么非得有酒。

lines.en: : And I normally begin to feel...impaired after just a glass of wine, so...
lines.zh: : 而且我平时只要一杯葡萄酒就开始……觉得晕了，所以……

lines.en: : I wanna see drunk Touka!
lines.zh: : 我想看醉了的 Touka！

lines.en: : You’re always so formal all the time. What if you’re like, super exciting when you’re drunk?
lines.zh: : 你平时总是那么一板一眼的。说不定你喝醉了会特别有意思呢？

lines.en: : Exciting {i}how{/i}?...
lines.zh: : 有意思{i}是指{/i}？……

lines.en: : Idunno. Like, maybe you start singing or dancing or get really mean and start trying to fight people.
lines.zh: : 不知道啦。比如说，你开始唱歌跳舞，或者变得特别凶，开始想跟人打架。

lines.en: : Fight people?...
: Well...you do spend most of your time with Yumi...so I suppose you just...enjoy hanging out with those types of people...
lines.zh: : 好吧……你大部分时间都跟 Yumi 混在一起……所以我想你就是……喜欢跟那种类型的人待在一起……

lines.en: scene postfashion46
: The fuck you mean by {i}those{/i} types of people?
lines.zh: : 你他妈说{i}那种{/i}类型的人是什么意思？

lines.en: : I...I meant no offense!
lines.zh: : 我……我没有冒犯的意思！

lines.en: : I’m just acknowledging Chika’s affinity for...more masculine women!
lines.zh: : 我只是在指出 Chika 对……更男性化的女性的偏好！

lines.en: : You saying I have a fuckin’ dick?
lines.zh: : 你是说我有根鸡巴？

lines.en: : Yay! Bonding!
lines.zh: : 耶！这就是 bonding（联谊）！

lines.en: : Now hurry up and take these beers so I don’t have to stand around holding them all night!
lines.zh: : 好了，快把这些啤酒拿走，我可不想举一整晚！

lines.en: : Hey, everyone. What’s going on over here?
lines.zh: : 嗨，各位。这边在干什么？

lines.en: scene postfashion47
: Sensei! You’ll drink with me, won’t you?
lines.zh: : 老师！你会陪我喝的吧？

lines.en: : These two are being total buzzkills.
lines.zh: : 这两个人完全是扫兴王。

lines.en: : I didn’t even know you liked drinking, Chika.
lines.zh: : 我还不知道你喜欢喝酒呢，Chika。

lines.en: : Well...I don’t, really.
lines.zh: : 嗯……其实也不算喜欢。

lines.en: : But...when in Rome, you know?
lines.zh: : 不过……入乡随俗嘛，你懂的？

lines.en: : We just finished battling it out with one another, so it makes sense for everybody to kick back and relax for a little while.
lines.zh: : 我们刚刚才互相斗了一场，所以大家放松一下也很合理。

lines.en: : Besides, if I get really drunk, no one will hold it against me if I start getting all up in your business! And I can just blame it on the alcohol if they do!
lines.zh: : 再说了，要是我喝得烂醉，就算我开始对你动手动脚，也没人会怪我！真要怪，我推给酒精就行了！

lines.en: : I see that you’ve completely and rationally thought all of this through, then.
lines.zh: : 看来你是把这一切都彻底且理性地想清楚了。

lines.en: : Sensei...what do you think I should do in this situation?
lines.zh: : 老师……你觉得我这种情况该怎么办？

lines.en: : Me?
: I’m supposed to look toward you for guidance, and I do not have much experience with peer pressure.
lines.zh: : 我本来应该向你寻求指导，而我对同辈压力实在没什么经验。

lines.en: : Looking to this guy for guidance probably ain’t the best idea, Tamako.
lines.zh: : 找这家伙求指导大概不是什么好主意，Tamako。

lines.en: : Touka.
lines.zh: : 是 Touka。

lines.en: : You tell her, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 说得好，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene postfashion48
: That is a completely different girl!
lines.zh: : 那是完全另一个女孩！

lines.en: if chika_lust >= 15:
: I think you should go for it, Touka.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你应该试试，Touka。

lines.en: : It’s not every day you get a chance to feel like a normal [high_school]er. And your mother {i}is{/i} right over there in the event that you get too hammered.
lines.zh: : 能像个普通的[high_school]生一样的机会可不是天天都{i}有{/i}的。而且你要是喝得太嗨，你妈妈就在那边。

lines.en: scene postfashion49
: Well...I suppose it is true that my mother would not intentionally put me in harm’s way.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我母亲确实不会故意把我置于危险之中，这倒是真的。

lines.en: : So perhaps I am just misinterpreting the concept of peer pressure and...just finally being included in something.
lines.zh: : 所以也许只是我误解了同辈压力这个概念……以及终于被接纳进某个圈子的感觉。

lines.en: : Well, there you go. Enjoy your youth.
lines.zh: : 这不就对了嘛。好好享受青春。

lines.en: : You gonna do it with me, Touka?
lines.zh: : 你要跟我一起喝吗，Touka？

lines.en: scene postfashion50
: What the heck. Why not?
lines.zh: : 管他呢。为什么不呢？

lines.en: : What’s the worst that could possibly happen?
lines.zh: : 最坏又能怎么样？

lines.en: scene black
I stay with Chika and Touka a little while longer as they “enjoy their youth” together.
lines.zh: 我又陪 Chika 和 Touka 多待了一会儿，看着她们一起“享受青春”。

lines.en: Of course, Yumi does not join in on the fun and, instead, heads back to the Chosokabe apartment to watch after Chinami.
lines.zh: 当然，Yumi 没有加入这场狂欢，而是回 Chosokabe 家去照看 Chinami 了。

lines.en: Apparently, the two of them let her spend the night at the apartment alone last night. But doing that two nights in a row is cause for concern.
lines.zh: 据说，她们俩昨晚让她一个人在公寓里过夜。但连着两晚都这样，就值得担心了。

lines.en: Either way, Chika and Touka proceed to drink.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，Chika 和 Touka 开始喝了起来。

lines.en: And drink.
lines.zh: 接着喝。

lines.en: And drink.
lines.zh: 再接着喝。

lines.en: And soon enough, the two of them can barely even walk and Maki has to drive them back to the hotel.
lines.zh: 很快，她们俩连路都快走不稳了，Maki 只好开车把她们送回酒店。

lines.en: I catch a ride as well, since basically everyone else has already left and...
lines.zh: 我也顺便搭了趟车，因为其他人大致都已经走了，而且……

lines.en: Well, I’m just really tired of walking...
lines.zh: 好吧，我只是真的走累了……

: If you don’t feel comfortable, just don’t do it.
lines.zh: : 如果你觉得不舒服，那就别喝。

lines.en: : But, like Yumi said, asking me for guidance is kind of antithetical to my entire outlook on your wellbeing.
lines.zh: : 不过就像 Yumi 说的，向我寻求指导，跟我对你身心健康的整体看法本来就是背道而驰的。

lines.en: scene postfashion51
: Anti...what? I didn't fuckin' say it like that.
lines.zh: : 背道……什么？我他妈可没那么说。

lines.en: : I see! Yes, that makes complete sense.
lines.zh: : 我明白了！是啊，这完全说得通。

lines.en: : It is one thing to experience youth and friendship, but it should not come at the cost of my own safety.
lines.zh: : 体验青春和友谊是一回事，但不该以我自身的安全为代价。

lines.en: : Besides, an abundance of alcohol can cause the body to bloat, and I simply can not condone the idea of looking anything less than perfect and presentable while out in public.
lines.zh: : 再说，过量饮酒会让身体浮肿，而我绝对不能容忍自己在公共场合看起来有一丝不够完美、不够体面。

lines.en: : Well, now I don’t really want to drink either...
lines.zh: : 嗯……那我现在也不太想喝了……

lines.en: : Perhaps we could play a game? Do you think this establishment has a copy of Monopoly?
lines.zh: : 那我们要不要玩个游戏？你觉得这家店里有大富翁吗？

lines.en: : I will say I am quite good at that game, so do not underestimate me.
lines.zh: : 我得说，我玩那个游戏相当厉害，所以别小看我。

lines.en: : I...guess we can do that instead...
lines.zh: : 我……想我们也可以玩那个……

lines.en: scene black
Chika, Touka and I...somehow wind up spending the night playing a board game.
lines.zh: Chika、Touka 和我……不知怎么的，最后玩了一整晚的桌游。

lines.en: Yumi, not wanting to be involved in any form (Which I do not blame her for) immediately leaves to go spend the night with Chinami.
lines.zh: Yumi 不想以任何形式参与（这一点我完全不怪她），立刻动身去陪 Chinami 过夜了。

lines.en: Apparently, she was left alone last night and the two of them are unwilling to let her do that two nights in a row.
lines.zh: 据说她昨晚被一个人留在家里，她们俩不愿意让她连着两晚都这样。

lines.en: Either way, Touka winds up winning (Go figure) and the three of us catch a ride back to the hotel with Maki shortly after...
lines.zh: 不管怎样，最后是 Touka 赢了（不出所料），没过多久我们三个就搭 Maki 的车回酒店了……
